title: Kagamine Rin — Lit By The Screen〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I hope Rui's okay...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Especially after hearing about how that really important scene wasn't going well...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (After talking about it with the director, he's been working so hard to try to figure out the answer...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I wish I could help somehow, but...)
Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, it's you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The plushies noticed that you're feeling down, and they're worried about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Normally, you'd have already gone to visit Tsukasa and the others to see how their film's coming along... What are you doing looking sullen in here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, I'm stuck...
I don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rui, the director and everyone have been putting so much effort into this film, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But this really important scene is giving Rui a lot of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want to help him somehow, but I feel like there's nothing I can do for him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nothing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... I was so excited about this when I first heard about it since we'd get to find out what it's like to make a film!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There were so many people, so much equipment and so much we didn't know... Which made everything sparkle!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I realize now that it's not all just fun and games...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They tried coming up with some ideas, but none really felt right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And they have to finish shooting it tomorrow no matter what. Rui's trying to figure out the answer right now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna help him if I can...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, you're certainly right about making a film not being all fun and games...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Because it's just like a show.
You have to put a lot of thought into it and overcome countless obstacles...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The problem Rui's trying to solve right now is an incredibly difficult one.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even so... I believe that there is something you can do for him, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
For example...
Say you were working on a show but you ended up hitting a wall. Then, imagine someone cheering you on from the sidelines...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you be bothered by them rooting for you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No way! They decided to do that after seeing that I was having trouble, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'd want to thank them and do the best I possibly can to figure out whatever's bothering me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I figured.
So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wouldn't Rui be feeling the same way?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You just said you'd feel encouraged by someone's willingness to help you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you showing your support for Rui will give him a nice boost of energy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So... I can help him...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe... Thanks, KAITO♪
I feel a lot better now☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If showing my support will help Rui, then I gotta go tell him that I'm there for him!
